Name: Yandere Harvey
Author: bhallspawns
Description:
[b]Please be careful when using other mods in addition to this mod that may slightly alter or add, or completely change, Harvey's dialogues and events.

[/b]This mod changes Harvey into a "Yandere". Included are his regular (with *slight* changes to some of her event dialogue depending on the choice of the player), her 1-year festivals, marriage, new 1.6 added, breakup & divorce + bouquet & pendant, and resort dialogues.

( Mods used in featured images: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6166]INTERFACE 1[/url] / [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26211]INTERFACE 2[/url] / [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25275]PORTRAITS[/url] )

Downloads.Description:
Yandere Harvey Mod. Starts at 2Heart.
**This update slightly changes some dialogues and adds more of them!**

Include Marriage dialogue, resort & 1-year festival dialogue, and more. Slightly alters *some* event dialogues, but does not change event.
